title: Planner Revision Output
description: Output contract for planner agents when revising plans in response to strategy review feedback. This schema complements strategy-review-output.schema.json and follows the same if/then conditional pattern for status-dependent field requirements. This structured data appears after a revision marker (e.g., REVISION:) when a planner incorporates review feedback.

status.description: The revision status. REVISED: plan has been updated to address feedback; UNCHANGED: planner believes no changes are needed (disagrees with feedback); BLOCKED: cannot revise (e.g., conflicting requirements).

addressed_issues.description: List of issue IDs from the review feedback that were addressed in this revision.

unaddressed_issues.description: List of issues from the review feedback that were not addressed, with explanations.

revision_summary.description: Summary of what changed in this revision. Required when status is 'REVISED'.

reason.description: Explanation for why no changes were made or why revision cannot proceed. Required when status is 'UNCHANGED' or 'BLOCKED'.

allOf.description: When REVISED, revision_summary and addressed_issues (with at least one issue) are required.
When BLOCKED, reason is required explaining why revision cannot proceed.
When UNCHANGED, reason is required explaining why no changes were made.

UnaddressedIssue.description: An issue from the review feedback that was not addressed, with explanation.

id.description: The issue ID from the review feedback.

reason.description: Explanation for why this issue was not addressed.

unaddressed_issues.reason: This is a strategy-level decision that needs to be resolved in the strategy document first

examples.revision_summary: Added error handling step with retry logic (SR-1-001). Enhanced schema with field validation patterns (SR-1-002). Updated success criteria to be more specific and testable.
Incorporated all feedback: added missing dependency analysis step, clarified deliverables with acceptance criteria, and added resource allocation section.

unaddressed_issues.reason: The suggested approach conflicts with existing architectural constraints documented in ADR-023
This requirement is already implicitly covered in Plan 3, step 4

examples.reason: All raised issues either conflict with documented constraints or are already addressed in the plan. No changes needed.
Cannot revise - feedback contains conflicting requirements: SR-1-001 requires synchronous processing while SR-1-003 mandates async approach
